newsitem.title: USA: Integon ends exchange of capital securities.
newsitem.headline: Integon ends exchange of capital securities.

text.p: Integon Corp said Monday it had completed its offer to exchange a series of capital securities for another series of the same securities.

The company said in a statement it exchanged up to $100 million in aggregate liquidation amount of its 10-3/4-percent Capital Securities, Series B for up to $100 million in aggregate liquidation amount of its outstanding 10-3/4-percent Capital Securities, Series A.
It said 100 percent of the securities were tendered for exchange.
Integon specializes in the underwriting and marketing of non-standard and other specialty automobile insurance products to individuals.
